articles.title: New US Attacks On Roads, Bridges Reported As Iran Hits Back At Gulf States
articles.summary: US strikes on Iran widened early on July 18 from the Strait of Hormuz hotspot to multiple sites throughout central and southern Iran, including through the use of fighter jets, while Iran continued to pound US Gulf allies, as a fragile cease-fire further tattered. New US Attacks On Roads, Bridges Reported As Iran Hits Back At Gulf States.

articles.title: Singapore chefs cook up chilli crab, laksa and chicken rice for 180 diners in Peru
articles.summary: Keng Eng Kee Seafood's Paul and Wayne Liew, Morsels' Petrina Loh and Canchita's Daniel and Tamara Chavez recently held a collaboration dinner at Lima's La Mar by Gaston Acurio, marking the first official, large-scale showcase of Singapore food in the Peruvian capital. articles.title: Reopening Hormuz Strait Easier Than Restoring Confidence, Naval Analyst Tallis Says
articles.summary: With the US and Iran launching fresh strikes in the Middle East, the Strait of Hormuz is back under the spotlight. Naval strategist Joshua Tallis says restoring commercial confidence -- not military force alone -- will determine when shipping returns to normal. Reopening Hormuz Strait Easier Than Restoring Confidence, Naval Analyst Tallis Says.

articles.title: Ukrainians Protest For A Second Day Over Defense Minister's Dismissal
articles.summary: Protests spread across Ukraine on July 17, two days after President Volodymyr Zelenskyy sacked the country's popular defense minister, Mykhaylo Fedorov, in a cabinet shakeup. Fedorov had reportedly clashed with Ukraine's top military leader over the country's wartime strategy. Ukrainians Protest For A Second Day Over Defense Minister's Dismissal.

articles.title: IOM warns of potential El Niño threat to families displaced by earthquake

articles.summary: ऑस्ट्रेलिया ने भारत की चोरी गई प्राचीन मूर्तियां और कलाकृतियां वापस करने का फैसला किया है. ऑस्ट्रेलिया की सरकार दोस्ती का सबूत देते हुए बिना किसी कानूनी खींचतान के भारत की वो तमाम बेशकीमती मूर्तियां और प्राचीन कलाकृतियां वापस करने का फैसला किया है, जो बरसों पहले हमारे देश से चोरी हो गई थीं. वहां के गृह मंत्री टोनी बर्क ने दुनिया के सामने साफ कह दिया है कि भारत की प्राचीन अमानत को अपने पास रखना सरासर चोरी है.
